data.action: 坐于水镜池边大理石阶，双腿朝观者伸展，赤足点水
data.animaCaption: On the steps of a moon temple she sits with her long legs stretched toward the viewer, her bare feet in the foreground adorned with fine golden ankle chains, toes dipping at the edge of the mirror pool as moonlight ripples across the water.
data.camera: 全景，正面构图，赤足前景特写
data.description: 满月之夜，尤诺坐于月神殿水镜池边的大理石阶上，双腿朝观者伸展，配着金脚镯与脚趾环的赤足置于前景，一只脚尖轻点水面，涟漪中映着满月。
data.lighting: 满月月光与水面倒影的幽蓝光
data.promptProse: Beneath a full moon, Iuno sits on the marble steps of the moon temple's mirror pool in her white-and-gold oracle gown, legs stretched toward the viewer, her bare feet with golden anklets resting at the water's edge.
data.title: 尤诺 · 月神水镜祭坛赤足点水
